labels.name: Macule
labels.function: Flat, non-palpable, under 1 cm; e.g. labial lentigines

labels.name: Patch
labels.function: Flat, non-palpable, over 1 cm; e.g. tinea versicolor

labels.name: Papule
labels.function: Raised solid dome under 1 cm; e.g. perioral dermatitis

labels.name: Plaque
labels.function: Elevated or indurated, over 1 cm; e.g. psoriasis at the elbow

labels.name: Nodule
labels.function: Raised dome over 1 cm that is solid throughout

labels.name: Cyst
labels.function: Over 1 cm with a soft or fluid center; note the punctum

labels.name: Vesicle
labels.function: Fluid-filled dome under 1 cm; e.g. hand-foot-mouth disease

labels.name: Bulla
labels.function: Tense fluid-filled dome over 1 cm; e.g. pemphigoid

labels.name: Pustule
labels.function: Dome of any size with purulent contents; e.g. AGEP

labels.name: Epidermis
labels.function: Outermost layer; its fetal migration paths are Blaschko lines

labels.name: Dermis
labels.function: Middle layer; plane of erysipelas; injury here leaves a scar

labels.name: Subcutis
labels.function: Deepest layer; plane of cellulitis

labels.name: Scale
labels.function: Dry dead cells from hyperproliferation or increased cohesion

labels.name: Erosion
labels.function: Partial loss of the top layer; heals without scarring

labels.name: Crust
labels.function: Dried serum, blood or pus after a vesicle, bulla or pustule

labels.name: Ulcer
labels.function: Loss of the top layer and part of the next; heals scarred

labels.name: Fissure
labels.function: Vertical crack with sharp walls, from the disease itself

labels.name: Lichenification
labels.function: Thick, hard skin with accentuated lines from chronic rubbing

labels.name: Annular
labels.function: Ring with central clearing, e.g. erythema migrans

labels.name: Targetoid
labels.function: Bullseye of alternating colors, e.g. erythema multiforme

labels.name: Grouped
labels.function: Clustering here is the key to diagnosing herpes

labels.name: Discrete
labels.function: Each lesion separate from the others, e.g. molluscum

labels.name: Confluent
labels.function: Smaller lesions coalesce into larger ones, as in lichen planus

labels.name: Linear
labels.function: Lesions distributed in a straight line, e.g. in psoriasis

labels.name: Serpiginous
labels.function: Snake-like winding track, e.g. cutaneous larva migrans

labels.name: Reticular
labels.function: Net-like arrangement of the lesions
